entry.title: 10 Handy Linux Terminal Tricks Every Beginner Should Know
entry.summary:
10 Handy Linux Terminal Tricks Every Beginner Should Know
Hi, I'm Mio! 👋 You've learned the basic commands — now let's make your terminal life a little more enjoyable. !! — Re-run the Previous Command
$ ls $ !!
Repeats the exact command you just ran. Simple, but surprisingly handy. !ls — Recall a Past Command by Name
$ !ls
Runs the most recent ls command from your history — no need to scroll through history. history | grep — Search Your Command History
$ history | grep ssh 53 ssh user@192.168.0.10 104 ssh user@example.com
Can't remember a command you ran last week? Pipe history into grep and find it instantly. alias — Create Your Own Shortcuts
$ alias ll='ls -la' $ ll
Tired of typing long commands? Create an alias. Add it to ~/.bashrc to make it permanent. $…
